title: Kernel coordinator for mixed-precision prefill-decode concurrency smoothing
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Problem: We observe intermittent 95p latency spikes during bursty prefill->decode handoffs when the runtime opportunistically switches between FlashAttention v2 and v3 kernels. Root cause analysis indicates three contributors: (1) mixed-precision selector choosing v3 for some layers leading to workspace reallocation, (2) concurrent KV-shard handoffs that contend for transient host memory, and (3) bursty arrival patterns that defeat the current prefill pacing heuristics. Goal: Implement a lightweight kernel coordinator that smooths concurrency at the handoff boundary, applies token-shape-aware admission control, and enforces a budgeted fallback policy so we meet our 95p SLO without regressing throughput or cost. High-level approach: (a) add a per-request concurrency window at prefill completion that delays decode-start for a short jittered period when memory pressure is high, (b) route borderline requests to an explicitly quantified v2-fallback path if v3 causes workspace reallocation above threshold, (c) introduce a KV-shard handoff semaphore with priority for hot-token prefixes, and (d) emit telemetry to drive an autosuggest to Optimize for batching/quantization. Trade-offs: the coordinator introduces small median latency overhead (target <4ms) to substantially reduce 95/99p spikes; alternative was conservative global disable of v3 which increases per-token cost. This ticket builds the coordinator shim, unit + e2e harness, and rollout automation. Links: design doc: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/RUN/Kernel+Coordinator+Proposal ; perf experiment PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4321 ; canary dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/attn-kernel-coordinator
acceptance_criteria: 95th percentile decode latency for bursty prefill scenarios improves to <= 80ms on target benchmark (long-tail load test), measured over 24h canary
Median latency increase <= 4ms and throughput regression < 3% on existing benchmark suite
Fallback to v2 path triggered and observable when workspace realloc threshold exceeded; documented in runtime logs
KV-shard handoff semaphore prevents concurrent host-memory oversubscription: host memory high watermark regressions eliminated in synthetic overload tests
End-to-end test harness added and deterministic (seeded) to reproduce previous spike pattern; CI integration added to nightly job
test_plan: Unit tests for coordinator state machine (admission, jitter, fallback decision)
Microbench harness that simulates mixed-precision layer assignments across models (gpt-like) and asserts workspace allocations
End-to-end stress test: 10k bursty prefill requests with variable sequence lengths (64/512/2048) to validate 95/99p behavior
Canary rollout for 24h on dedicated pool 'canary-prefill-3' with traffic split 5% and full telemetry capture
Backcompat regression test to ensure no change in deterministic outputs when kernel path is functionally equivalent
rollout_plan: Stage 0: feature-flagged unit tests and internal review (now)
Stage 1: deploy to canary pool 'canary-prefill-3' at 5% traffic for 24h, monitor 95/99p latencies and host memory heatmaps
Stage 2: increase to 20% for 48h if canary stable; enable autosuggest telemetry to Optimize UI
Stage 3: gradual ramp to 100% over 3 days with rollback windows, final enablement in runtime-1.22 release
Rollback triggers: >10% regression in throughput, 95p decode latency >150ms, or unexplained host memory OOMs
monitoring_and_alerting: New Grafana panel: attn.coordinator.95p_decode_latency (per model, per pool)
Alert: attn.coordinator.95p_latency_over_slo fires if >95p > 120ms for 10m during canary
Host memory oversubscription alert tied to coordinator KVS semaphore wait count > 1000/s
Trace sampling: record kernel path selection and fallback reason in span attributes (tag: kernel.path, kernel.fallback_reason)
implementation_notes: Coordinator runs as a lightweight in-process shim inside runtime request path; avoids RPCs to keep jitter low
Admission window default: 8-24ms jittered based on recent host memory pressure and per-model token-shape distribution
Fallback decision: compute estimated workspace delta for chosen kernel; trigger v2 fallback if delta > 20% of workspace budget
KV-shard semaphore is leaky-bucket style with weighted priority for cached prefixes (hot-token heuristics)
dependencies_notes: Depends on ENG-421999 (telemetry schemas) and ENG-55221 (kv-shard handoff primitives). Also coordinate with PM/Console team for Optimize autosuggest integration (ENG-305678).
